summary: Sprott Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, reporting its quarterly earnings and financial results for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes management's discussion and analysis, interim condensed consolidated financial statements, CEO and CFO certifications, and a press release. Assets under management were $65.1 billion as of March 31, 2026, up 9% from year-end 2025, with net income of $29.2 million ($1.13 per share). This is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation transaction. No deal terms, activist campaign, strategic review, or corporate action beyond normal operations are present.
